propositions: A contributor-writable Gerrit comment containing recheck-review re-runs the LLM-Review lane on the current patch set without requiring a new revision push.

The trigger refuses (declines to enqueue, posts refusal reply, logs RETRIGGER_REFUSED) if the current-revision LLM-Review vote is a real finding-BLOCK, including both bare and merge-change forms, preventing dice-rolled self-approval of stochastic verdicts.
On acceptance, the trigger resets the shared attempts budget (0347 bounded-retry ledger) and enqueues the change with _rebar_force marker, bypassing dedup and existing-vote short-circuits.

The eligibility gate reads the bot's persisted LLM-Review vote MESSAGE TAG from Gerrit's authoritative state via GET /changes/{id}/messages (ChangeMessageInfo), parsing all three production tag shapes: _TAG_SUFFIXES members, hardcoded merge-review literal, and in-tag (merge-change, N) suffix, treating unparseable/absent tags as ELIGIBLE (fail-open to fresh fail-closed review).
Comments authored by the bot itself and comments lacking the recheck-review token are silent no-ops (no reply, no enqueue).

The refusal and queued-reply paths post messages to Gerrit via POST /changes/{id}/revisions/{rev}/review with message-only JSON body (no labels key) to avoid vote displacement, and /rerun operator endpoint also resets attempts budget before enqueueing to harmonize retry semantics.
